title: WHAT IF YOU COULD SELL YOUR MEMORIES FOR CASH? 🧠💰 (Animated Short Film)
description:
Deep beneath the financial district, an unmarked glass skyscraper houses Mnemosyne Biometrics. Their proposition is simple: memories are neural electrical patterns, and they will pay in cold cash. For his awkward high school graduation, Pip receives two hundred thousand dollars wired directly to his phone.

Within six months, selling memories becomes an obsession. He sells his painful first heartbreak for one million dollars, and childhood injuries for five hundred thousand. Pip buys a three-story glass penthouse, six luxury supercars, and throws rooftop parties every night. Pip feels completely weightless—no regrets, no nostalgia, just pure wealth.

Then came Year Two. One morning, Pip finds a framed photograph on his bedside table of an elderly woman holding a baby with Pip's eyes. Warm tears stream down his cheeks, but when he searches his mind, there is only static. He had sold the memory of his own mother to buy a yacht in Monaco. He stares into the bathroom mirror at a wealthy stranger.

Desperate to escape the creeping hollow inside his chest, Pip returns to the clinic. In the sterile white vault, the chief neurosurgeon slides a black titanium contract across the table: Fifty million dollars in gold bearer bonds for his core identity. His name, his values, his morals, his humor, and his soul.

═══════════════════════════════════════════
💬 THE ULTIMATE EXISTENTIAL DILEMMA:
═══════════════════════════════════════════
Pip holds the glowing glass canister containing the last remaining fragments of his soul:
👉 Option A: "BUY BACK YOUR SOUL — Return all $30 Million, go back to being broke, but remember your mother and keep your identity."
👉 Option B: "TAKE THE $50,000,000 — Erase your past permanently and live as an empty, nameless billionaire."

Drop your choice in the comments below! We read and heart every single comment. ❤️
